name: coldoutreach
description: Custom email template generator — full-stack TypeScript monorepo.

scripts.dev: bun run --cwd common build && bun --filter '@emailstrat/frontend' --filter '@emailstrat/backend' --parallel dev
scripts.dev:backend: bun run --cwd common build && bun run --cwd backend dev
scripts.setup:backend: bun run --cwd common build && cd backend && bunx convex dev --once
scripts.build: bun run --cwd common build && bun run --cwd frontend build
scripts.test: bun run --cwd common test && bun run --cwd frontend test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd common typecheck && bun run --cwd frontend typecheck
